βάλῃ: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. subj. 3 sg., tmesis ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’, in a purpose clause · also plain (no tmesis), ’strike, hit’ + acc., in a clause of fearing with μή: μή πώς μ’ ... βάλῃ ’lest it strike me’
γιγνομένῳ: γίγνομαι — be born, become; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he was being born’
δῆμος: δῆμος — people, community; masc. nom. sg.
θήσει: τίθημι — put, make; fut. 3 sg.: ’will make’ (with double acc.)
καθεζώμεσθα: καθέζομαι — sit down; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us sit down’
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
κατήλθομεν: κατέρχομαι — come/go down; aor. 1 pl. (distinct stem from κατήλυθον, same sense)
κτείνῃς: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. subj. 2 sg.
κυανοχαίτης: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon); masc. nom. sg. as a noun: ’the dark-haired one’
κῆτος: κῆτος — sea-monster (any large sea-creature, not necessarily a whale); neut. acc. sg.
μεθορμηθεὶς: μεθορμάομαι — dart after, rush after (μετά + ὁρμάω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
μητιόωντες: μητιάω — devise, plan, contrive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶντες)
νέμηαι: νέμομαι — have the use of, enjoy, possess; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic νέμῃ), purpose after ὄφρα
νευστάζων: νευστάζω — nod repeatedly, make signs; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’nodding’
οὐρῇ: οὐρά — tail; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic οὐρᾷ), dat. of means: ’with his tail’
πέφνῃ: πέφνω (defective, aor. only) — slay, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., with ὅς κε: ’who shall slay’
πεύσεται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire by asking; fut. 3 sg., + gen.: ’he will learn (of)’
φιλέουσιν: φιλέω — love; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦσι)
χαλεποὶ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
ἀλέαιτο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, escape; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic, in a potential clause: ‘could avoid’
ἅπαν: ἅπας — all, the whole; neut. nom. sg. (δάπεδον ἅπαν ’the whole floor’)
ἐναργεῖς: ἐναργής — visible, manifest, in bodily presence; masc. nom. pl.
ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
ὑψηλόν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), agreeing with σπέος: ’(a cave) high’
